item.description:
0.4.0

A port forward no longer needs a terminal to live in.

  • Local tunnel is a kind of session. It holds its ports open with no shell, and shows what is listening, where it goes and how many bytes have moved.
  • It points at a host you already saved and borrows its account, key and jump chain — you never enter the same machine twice.
  • Backspace deletes again in the file browser, and ⌘↑ goes up a folder. ⌘Z and ⌘X now work everywhere.
  • You can choose where downloads go, in Settings ▸ Files.
  • The host editor was wider than its sheet, so the right edge of every row was clipped. Fixed.
